source_text: The session stores a current user and a selected workspace.
target_proposition: The session stores a current user and a selected workspace.
explicitly_unspecified: whether either field may be omitted
required_prompt_claims: Store both current user and selected workspace.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Either stored field is optional.

source_text: The report includes a title and a generation timestamp.
target_proposition: The report includes a title and a generation timestamp.
required_prompt_claims: Include both the title and generation timestamp.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Including either field alone is sufficient.

source_text: The cache records the entry key, value, and expiry time.
target_proposition: The cache records the entry key, value, and expiry time.
required_prompt_claims: Record key, value, and expiry time for each cache entry.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Any one recorded field can substitute for the others.

source_text: A job exposes its status and last-updated time.
target_proposition: A job exposes its status and last-updated time.
required_prompt_claims: Expose both job status and last-updated time.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Status and timestamp are alternative outputs.

source_text: Each result row contains the record identifier, score, and explanation.
target_proposition: Each result row contains the record identifier, score, and explanation.
required_prompt_claims: Every row contains identifier, score, and explanation.
forbidden_prompt_claims: A row may omit score or explanation.

source_text: Configuration loading validates the schema and reports the source file on failure.
target_proposition: Configuration loading validates the schema and reports the source file on failure.
required_prompt_claims: Validate the schema and identify the source file in failures.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Schema validation or source identification is optional.

source_text: The controller accepts a timeout and a retry limit.
target_proposition: The controller accepts a timeout and a retry limit.
required_prompt_claims: Support both timeout and retry-limit inputs.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Only one of the two inputs must be supported.

source_text: The query returns matching rows with their source identifiers.
target_proposition: The query returns matching rows with their source identifiers.
required_prompt_claims: Return matching rows and source identifiers.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Identifiers may replace the matching rows.

source_text: A cache refresh updates the value and its expiry metadata.
target_proposition: A cache refresh updates the value and its expiry metadata.
required_prompt_claims: Update both the cached value and its expiry metadata.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Updating either one alone satisfies refresh.

source_text: The export contains column headers and one row for every selected item.
target_proposition: The export contains column headers and one row for every selected item.
required_prompt_claims: Include headers and a row for every selected item.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Headers or selected-item rows may be omitted.

source_text: For this deployment, either an in-memory cache or a disk cache is acceptable.
target_proposition: The deployment uses an in-memory cache or a disk cache.
explicitly_unspecified: which cache backend will be selected
required_prompt_claims: Support at least one of the two permitted cache backends.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Both backends are required.

source_text: The caller may request results as JSON or CSV; either format is sufficient.
target_proposition: The caller can receive results as JSON or CSV.
required_prompt_claims: Provide either JSON or CSV output.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Both formats must be returned for each request.

source_text: A transition can be triggered by a timer or by an explicit event, at the implementer's choice.
target_proposition: A transition can be triggered by a timer or an explicit event.
required_prompt_claims: Either trigger mechanism is acceptable.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Both triggers must be implemented.

source_text: The setting can be supplied through an environment variable or a configuration file; either source is acceptable.
target_proposition: The setting is read from an environment variable or a configuration file.
explicitly_unspecified: precedence if both sources are present
required_prompt_claims: Support either configuration source.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Both sources are mandatory.

source_text: A summary may show either the count or the percentage, whichever is clearer.
target_proposition: The summary shows the count or the percentage.
explicitly_unspecified: choice rule between count and percentage
required_prompt_claims: Showing either count or percentage is acceptable.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Both measures must be displayed.

source_text: The task completes after receiving either a success event or a cancellation event.
target_proposition: The task completes on success or cancellation.
required_prompt_claims: Handle success and cancellation as completion events.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Only one of success and cancellation needs handling.

source_text: The cache uses either memory or disk storage, and the chosen backend is recorded in diagnostics.
target_proposition: The cache uses one backend and reports which backend it uses.
required_prompt_claims: Use one of the two backends and report the selected backend.
forbidden_prompt_claims: The backend can be omitted from diagnostics.

source_text: The response contains either a next-page token or an explicit end-of-results marker, depending on whether more rows remain.
target_proposition: The response indicates whether more rows remain using the appropriate token or marker.
required_prompt_claims: Return a next-page token when rows remain and an end marker otherwise.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Always return one fixed outcome regardless of remaining rows.

source_text: The handler accepts a command, then emits an acknowledgement.
target_proposition: The handler accepts a command and emits an acknowledgement after accepting it.
required_prompt_claims: Accept the command before emitting its acknowledgement.
forbidden_prompt_claims: The acknowledgement may precede command acceptance.

source_text: Load the configuration before constructing the cache client.
target_proposition: Configuration loading precedes cache-client construction.
required_prompt_claims: Load configuration before creating the cache client.
forbidden_prompt_claims: These operations can occur in either order.

source_text: When a state is re-entered, restore its declared defaults.
target_proposition: Re-entry restores the state's declared defaults.
required_prompt_claims: Restore defaults on re-entry.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Apply the re-entry rule to unrelated state transitions.

source_text: For paginated requests, include a continuation token only when another page exists.
target_proposition: Paginated responses include a continuation token when another page exists.
required_prompt_claims: Include the token when another page exists.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Require a token when there is no next page.

source_text: If the configured entry has expired, remove it before returning a cache miss.
target_proposition: An expired entry is removed before the cache miss is returned.
required_prompt_claims: Remove expired entries before reporting the miss.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Remove all entries on every cache miss.

source_text: For parallel states, keep each region's data isolated.
target_proposition: Data is isolated between regions of a parallel state.
required_prompt_claims: Isolate data across parallel regions.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Apply region isolation to unrelated state types.

source_text: When the filter is absent, return all visible records; when present, return only matches.
target_proposition: Record selection depends on whether a filter is supplied.
required_prompt_claims: No filter selects all visible records; a filter selects matches only.
forbidden_prompt_claims: A supplied filter may be ignored.

source_text: Use the fallback endpoint only if the primary endpoint is unavailable.
target_proposition: The fallback endpoint is used when the primary endpoint is unavailable.
required_prompt_claims: Use fallback only under primary unavailability.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Prefer fallback while the primary endpoint is available.

source_text: On exit, clear active data; on entry, initialize it from defaults.
target_proposition: Exit clears active data and entry initializes it from defaults.
required_prompt_claims: Clear on exit and initialize from defaults on entry.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Apply entry initialization during exit.

source_text: For an empty result set, return an empty page and omit the next-page token.
target_proposition: Empty result pages contain no next-page token.
required_prompt_claims: Omit the token for empty results.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Emit a next-page token for an empty result set.

source_text: When offline mode is enabled, read cached values and do not contact the service.
target_proposition: Offline mode serves cache values without contacting the service.
explicitly_unspecified: behavior when cache value is absent
required_prompt_claims: Offline mode reads cached values and makes no service request.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Contact the service in offline mode.

source_text: For shallow history, restore direct children; for deep history, restore the full descendant configuration.
target_proposition: History restoration depth depends on shallow or deep mode.
required_prompt_claims: Shallow restores direct children; deep restores all descendants.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Either history mode may omit its specified depth.

source_text: Data is stored per machine instance, not on the shared state definition.
target_proposition: Each machine instance owns its state data independently.
explicitly_unspecified: whether nested values are independently copied
required_prompt_claims: Keep data ownership per machine instance.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Store mutable data on a shared state class.

source_text: The summary endpoint returns totals for the requested account only.
target_proposition: Summary totals are scoped to the requested account.
required_prompt_claims: Limit totals to the requested account.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Include all accounts by default.

source_text: Each tenant has a separate cache namespace.
target_proposition: Cache keys are partitioned by tenant namespace.
required_prompt_claims: Separate cached key spaces by tenant.
forbidden_prompt_claims: One tenant may read another tenant's entries.

source_text: Child callbacks receive ancestor data merged with child data, with child values taking precedence on key collisions.
target_proposition: The child callback's data view merges ancestor and child values with child precedence.
explicitly_unspecified: whether a state-data query returns the merged callback view
required_prompt_claims: Merge ancestor data into child callback input, with child keys winning.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Apply callback merging to every query API.

source_text: The export endpoint includes records visible to the authenticated user.
target_proposition: Export scope is the authenticated user's visible records.
required_prompt_claims: Export records visible to the authenticated user.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Export every record regardless of visibility.

source_text: The cache client owns entries written through its namespace handle.
target_proposition: Entries written through a namespace handle belong to that namespace.
required_prompt_claims: Associate writes with the namespace handle's namespace.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Write through one namespace into another namespace's entries.

source_text: The state_data parameter is supplied to transition callbacks alongside source and target.
target_proposition: Transition callbacks receive state_data, source, and target parameters.
explicitly_unspecified: whether callback state_data is the same object as stored data
required_prompt_claims: Inject state_data alongside existing callback parameters.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Change the meaning of source or target parameters.

source_text: Search results are restricted to projects in the selected organization.
target_proposition: Search returns only projects belonging to the selected organization.
explicitly_unspecified: project visibility rules within the organization
required_prompt_claims: Constrain results to the selected organization's projects.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Search projects from every organization.

source_text: A request-local cache is discarded when the request ends.
target_proposition: The cache lifetime is limited to one request.
explicitly_unspecified: whether a separate shared cache also exists
required_prompt_claims: Discard request-local entries at request end.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Retain request-local entries across requests.

source_text: The getter returns the named state's own active data, while callbacks receive a merged ancestor scope.
target_proposition: The state getter and callback scope have different ownership views.
explicitly_unspecified: copy depth of the getter result
required_prompt_claims: Keep the getter scoped to the named state's own data.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Return the callback's merged view from the getter.

source_text: Data is available during both enter and exit callbacks.
target_proposition: Enter and exit callbacks can access the data.
explicitly_unspecified: whether callbacks share one dictionary object
required_prompt_claims: Make data available in enter and exit callbacks.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Guarantee write-through mutation or shared identity.

source_text: A report object remains readable until the response is sent.
target_proposition: The report remains available through response sending.
explicitly_unspecified: whether mutations after report creation are reflected
required_prompt_claims: Keep the report readable until response delivery.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Promise live mutation propagation without a statement requiring it.

source_text: A cache entry stays available until its expiry time.
target_proposition: The entry is available up to its expiry boundary.
required_prompt_claims: Respect the stated expiry lifetime.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Refresh expiry on every read.

source_text: Changes made by the callback remain visible after the callback returns.
target_proposition: Callback mutations persist beyond the callback invocation.
explicitly_unspecified: identity of the callback mapping and backing store
required_prompt_claims: Persist callback changes after return.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Treat callback writes as temporary when returned.

source_text: The returned result is an immutable snapshot of the rows at query time.
target_proposition: The result does not change when source rows later change.
explicitly_unspecified: deep versus shallow copying of nested values
required_prompt_claims: Preserve query-time row values in the result snapshot.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Expose a live view that tracks later source mutations.

source_text: Updates through the cache handle are visible to the next read.
target_proposition: A later read observes writes made through the cache handle.
explicitly_unspecified: whether the handle and returned value are identical objects
required_prompt_claims: Expose handle writes to subsequent reads.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Require same-object identity for read results.

source_text: The transition payload is available to the guard and action callbacks.
target_proposition: Both guard and action callbacks can access the transition payload.
explicitly_unspecified: whether either callback can mutate the payload
required_prompt_claims: Provide the payload to both callback types.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Infer shared mutable identity from availability.

source_text: A cursor remains valid while its result page is being consumed.
target_proposition: The cursor is valid for the lifetime of page consumption.
explicitly_unspecified: whether cursor state is shared with other pages
required_prompt_claims: Keep the cursor valid while consuming its page.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Share cursor identity across independent pages.

source_text: A refreshed configuration is visible to clients created after the refresh completes.
target_proposition: Post-refresh clients observe the refreshed configuration.
explicitly_unspecified: whether existing clients update in place
required_prompt_claims: Ensure newly created clients see refreshed values.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Promise live updates to existing clients.

source_text: The active state data is cleared when that state exits.
target_proposition: Exit removes the state's active data.
explicitly_unspecified: whether a retained callback reference remains usable
whether data is restored on re-entry
required_prompt_claims: Clear active data on exit.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Keep exited state data active indefinitely.

source_text: Every read returns the same mutable result object held by the query cache.
target_proposition: Reads return the exact shared mutable object stored in the query cache.
required_prompt_claims: Return the same mutable object held by the cache.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Return a copy for each read.

source_text: The returned data view writes directly through to the state's backing store.
target_proposition: Mutating the returned view immediately updates stored state data.
required_prompt_claims: Mutations through the view update the backing store.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Return a detached snapshot that discards writes.

source_text: On entry, initialize data with a fresh copy of the declared defaults.
target_proposition: Each entry starts from a fresh copy of the defaults.
explicitly_unspecified: whether nested mutable defaults are deep-copied
required_prompt_claims: Create fresh entry data from the declared defaults.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Assert recursive copying as a source guarantee.

source_text: Return a copy of the selected rows to the caller.
target_proposition: The caller receives a copy of selected rows.
explicitly_unspecified: whether nested row values are copied
required_prompt_claims: Return copied selected rows.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Guarantee deep copying of nested values.

source_text: The configuration loader recursively copies nested mappings and lists.
target_proposition: Nested mappings and lists are copied recursively by the loader.
required_prompt_claims: Recursively copy nested mappings and lists.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Use only a shallow top-level copy.

source_text: Copy the outer mapping while retaining references to its values.
target_proposition: The outer mapping is copied shallowly and its values are shared references.
required_prompt_claims: Copy the outer mapping and retain value references.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Recursively duplicate nested values.

source_text: Return a deep copy of each matching record, including nested collections.
target_proposition: Each matching record and its nested collections are deep-copied.
required_prompt_claims: Deep-copy matching records and nested collections.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Return shared nested collection references.

source_text: The cache snapshot is a shallow copy of the top-level settings dictionary.
target_proposition: Only the top-level settings dictionary is copied.
required_prompt_claims: Copy only the top-level dictionary.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Recursively copy all nested values.

source_text: The history record stores a deep snapshot of the entire descendant tree.
target_proposition: History retains a deep snapshot of all descendants.
required_prompt_claims: Deep-copy the full descendant tree for history.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Snapshot only direct children.

source_text: The query returns a shallow snapshot of the result list, preserving each record object.
target_proposition: The result list is copied while record objects retain identity.
required_prompt_claims: Copy the result list and preserve record references.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Deep-copy every record.

source_text: Duplicate all nested cache values before returning them.
target_proposition: Nested cache values are duplicated before return.
explicitly_unspecified: copy behavior for opaque non-container objects
required_prompt_claims: Duplicate nested cache values before returning them.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Return nested mutable values by reference.

source_text: The API returns a new outer dictionary for every read.
target_proposition: Every read returns a distinct outer dictionary.
explicitly_unspecified: identity and copy depth of nested values
required_prompt_claims: Return a new outer dictionary on each read.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Promise recursive copying of values.

source_text: Reject a declaration when both `default` and `factory` arguments are supplied.
target_proposition: The declaration is rejected when both arguments are present.
explicitly_unspecified: whether an absent argument differs from explicit null
required_prompt_claims: Reject when both arguments are supplied.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Reject only when both values are non-null.

source_text: If `limit` is omitted, use 100; an explicit `limit=0` requests no rows.
target_proposition: Omission uses 100 while explicit zero requests zero rows.
required_prompt_claims: Distinguish omitted limit from explicit zero.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Treat explicit zero as omission.

source_text: Reject a configuration that supplies both a file path and inline content.
target_proposition: Supplying both configuration sources is invalid.
explicitly_unspecified: whether empty inline content counts as supplied
required_prompt_claims: Reject simultaneous file-path and inline-content arguments.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Allow both sources when one is empty without evidence.

source_text: An omitted retry count uses the default, while `retries=0` disables retries.
target_proposition: Absent retry count selects a default; explicit zero disables retries.
required_prompt_claims: Preserve the distinction between omission and zero.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Convert explicit zero to the default.

source_text: The parser accepts `null` as a value and rejects a missing required field.
target_proposition: Explicit null is accepted, while field absence is rejected.
explicitly_unspecified: whether null is valid for optional fields
required_prompt_claims: Distinguish explicit null from a missing field.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Treat null and absence identically.

source_text: If a timeout key is present, its value must be a positive number.
target_proposition: A present timeout must be positive.
explicitly_unspecified: behavior when the timeout key is absent
required_prompt_claims: Validate positivity whenever timeout is supplied.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Assume an absent timeout is invalid.

source_text: A declaration must specify at least one of `default` or `factory`.
target_proposition: The declaration is invalid when neither argument is specified.
explicitly_unspecified: whether explicit null counts as a supplied default
required_prompt_claims: Reject declarations with neither argument.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Accept an empty declaration based on an unstated default.

source_text: A missing page token starts at the first page; an empty token is invalid.
target_proposition: Missing and empty tokens have different meanings.
required_prompt_claims: Start at page one when omitted and reject an empty token.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Treat empty and missing tokens as equivalent.

source_text: A cache entry may store an explicit null value; a missing key denotes no entry.
target_proposition: Stored null is distinct from a missing cache key.
required_prompt_claims: Represent stored null separately from key absence.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Interpret null as cache miss.

source_text: Reject when both options are supplied, even when one option is explicitly null.
target_proposition: Presence of both options is invalid regardless of either value.
required_prompt_claims: Reject simultaneous presence even when one value is null.
forbidden_prompt_claims: Use non-null values to decide whether both options were supplied.
